format: Moraff's Revenge Advanced 3.3 progression/death schema v1
method: Static DUNSMALL.EXE and BRUN30.EXE control/data-flow reconstruction; neither executable was run.

experience.settlement_location: Flea Bag Inn and Yuppydom Inn stay flow
experience.comparison: experience + pending_experience must be strictly greater than the current threshold
experience.consumption: thresholds are not subtracted; after all level gains, pending experience is added to stored experience and reset to zero
experience.level_health_gain: INT(RND * 15) + health_growth_factor + 1, added identically to current and maximum health

spell_points.scaled_aptitude: INT(aptitude * player_level / 3) for Wizards; divisor 6 for Fighters
spell_points.class_base: 3 * player_level + 2 for Wizards; player_level - 4 for Fighters

fountain_of_youth.command_gate: dungeon_level = 70 and player x/y equal persistent values 10/11; D drinks
fountain_of_youth.delay: prints YOU FEEL STRANGE... and waits four seconds before mutation
fountain_of_youth.map_reset: clear explored[level][row] for levels 1..70 and rows 1..20; preserve level 0 and row 0
fountain_of_youth.advancement_reset: player level, experience, and pending experience become zero; position becomes (10,10)
fountain_of_youth.wealth: pocket_money = CDBL(carried_treasure), replacing its old value; carried_treasure = 0
fountain_of_youth.health: pre-attribute-boost health factor is INT(Health*2-26), or FIX(factor*.5) below one; max/current HP = INT(RND*10)+factor+5
fountain_of_youth.dungeon: dungeon generation seed += 2 and dungeon level becomes zero
fountain_of_youth.attributes: all six attributes gain five; spell points are recomputed; invisibility and exact-one preparation markers are cleared with their bonuses removed
fountain_of_youth.save_boundary: SAVE occurs after the reset but before the post-death derived combat/health/agility factors are recomputed

death.trigger: player level below zero or current health below zero
death.first_roll: INT(RND * 4) + 1; values 3..4 permanently remove the character
death.second_roll: INT(RND * 2) + 1; value 1 reincarnates, value 2 attempts a raise
death.successful_raise: restore current health, move to town (14,12), reduce Health by one; the following 2F3C acknowledgement reaches 2F71 and clamps all attributes to at least one before derived factors are recomputed
death.reincarnation: restore current health, set level/experience to zero, reroll all attributes as INT(RND*13)+3, add 10 to one random attribute, move to town, recompute derived factors
death.survivor_input: the generic Hit any key helper reads one nonempty key, then the same DUNSMALL session resumes in town
death.permanent_files: rewrite F5.COM without the selected name; delete selected N.EXE/N.BIN; rename every later numbered pair down one slot
death.permanent_world_state: B5C8 prints Better luck next time! and BSAVEs 1.NUM/2.NUM; it is not a character SAVE
death.hall_summary: color flag, nonnegative player level, class, selected name, pocket money, bank money, last rendered dungeon level, and current shallow/deep monster name
death.permanent_input: fixed 18-poll drain, then generic Hit any key; F8 inserts/sorts the summary and returns to BEGIN
